objective: Test whether projecting each request in a packed multi-request prefill at its natural row count restores the trusted sequential FP8 qkvz arithmetic and strict c2 output identity.

candidate.scope: XPU Qwen GDN pure-prefill calls with more than one prefill request; c1, decode, speculative decode, and mixed decode/prefill calls remain unchanged.
candidate.implementation: Read the current layer's GDN prefill query boundaries, slice hidden_states into one contiguous natural-length tensor per request, call the existing quantized in_proj_qkvz on each slice, and concatenate results in scheduler order. Do not pad, change weights or scales, or reorder requests.
candidate.reason: R87 proved that fixed-256 padding selects the same wrong path as the natural packed 59-row c2 call. Natural 31-row c1 is the trusted oracle path; request isolation should reproduce it for cache-c000 while also giving index-c001 its natural 28-row path.

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing candidate from the production lineage and run repeated c1/c2 plus the broader varied-prompt determinism and quality battery. Measure prefill overhead separately. This diagnostic run cannot promote speed.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and localize the first layer-0 post-projection divergence without widening the candidate.
promotion_boundary: Candidate only. No site, README, headline, protected-speed, recipe-default, or LocalMaxxing authority. This boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
